proposal.name: Keep run records through failed GitHub pushes

plan.name: Keep run records through failed GitHub pushes
plan.summary: Make Clone.Record and Clone.Finish read back the run ref after every failed push: the exact commit this call tried to publish means success, another commit ends the call (ErrRecorded for Record), and Finish still rejects a run that was already finished when the call began. When the read confirms the original expected ref value (absent for Record), retry GitHub failures after 15, 30, 60 and 120 seconds, at most five pushes of the same commit with the same force-with-lease expectation; stop on refusal, an unreadable or changed ref, canceled or expired context, lost lease or stale tenure, and return the last push error on exhaustion. Reuse the GitHub failure classifier, extending it for Git's numeric HTTP errors, fatal error in commit_refs_rules, timeout and dropped-connection diagnostics while preserving refusal precedence, and carry the watcher's permission check through to every attempt without holding the clone lock during waits or blocking lease renewal. Extend the existing run, lease and classifier tests alongside the acceptance tests, preserving nonce uniqueness, atomic ref updates, the existing tenure/resumed-run rules and the other effects' retry policies. Update the recovery section of docs/factory.md and the matching SPEC.md bullet with these tested rules, and clarify the README's recovery sentence to distinguish within-step run pushes from later-poll retries; cite D-0069, D-0073, D-0113, D-0237, D-0265, D-0266, D-0122 and D-0294 as applicable, with the new retry decision to be recorded by the merger because plumbing builds cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestRunPush545ReconcilesLandedWrites
tests.says: Record and Finish succeed when a failed push actually published this call's commit, while a later call still cannot record or finish that run again.

tests.name: TestRunPush545RetriesWithBoundedBackoff
tests.says: Both run writes survive one through four transient failures, wait 15, 30, 60 and 120 seconds within the call, reconcile each failure and reuse the original commit and compare-and-swap expectation.

tests.name: TestRunPush545ExhaustsWithLastError
tests.says: Both writes stop after five failed pushes and four waits, return the final push's diagnostic and leave the remote record unchanged.

tests.name: TestRunPush545StopsOnRefusalOrChangedRef
tests.says: A refusal, a competing record or result, a deleted Finish ref or an unreadable ref stops retries immediately, including after a transient first attempt; Record preserves ErrRecorded for another writer.

tests.name: TestRunPush545HonorsContextAndLease
tests.says: Cancellation and deadlines interrupt either backoff, and every retry through leasedRepo checks current lease and step tenure before pushing.

tests.name: TestRunPush545WaitAllowsLeaseRenewal
tests.says: A waiting run write leaves its clone available to renew the lease, and cancellation then stops the write without another push.

tests.name: TestGitRunPush545FailureClassification
tests.says: Git's 5xx, commit_refs_rules failure, timeout and dropped-connection errors are transient, but explicit refusal statuses and ordinary Git rejections remain refusals even beside transient words.

usage.summary: Wrote `plan.json` and seven acceptance tests covering run-push recovery, with the required documentation changes included in the plan. The first check passed: all seven tests fail on the unchanged base, as required.
